# ADR-001: Fixable Date Format

FM-006 recognizes the slash form, so Phase 1 rewrites `created` to ISO 8601
and FM-011 has nothing left to report. A dry run reports both: the rewrite
FM-006 would make, and the FM-011 finding the file still has on disk.
